notes: Machine-readable form of ARES_PRESSURE_NOTES.md. status: WORLD (a toy world exists in ares/worlds.py this cycle), PROTOCOL (a sweep-level procedure, not a world), CANDIDATE (no toy yet). Every source in the notes is FROM MEMORY this cycle.

pressures.name: catastrophic_asymmetry
pressures.definition: Loss distribution with a rare, weakly cued left tail whose single cost exceeds the sum of ordinary lifetime rewards.
pressures.toy: Two noisy channels; acting pays +1/-1 on channel A's sign; when a latent danger (leaking into channel B) is on, acting wipes 90% of accumulated reward and costs 5 more. No detector given.

controls.absent: tail replaced by an ordinary -3 penalty at the same moments
controls.shuffled: catastrophes at the same rate but independent of the cued danger

pressures.expected_effect: Present champions condition the action rate on channel B and not only on channel A; absent champions ignore B; shuffled champions ignore B.
pressures.falsification: Present, absent and shuffled champions are structurally indistinguishable and the behavioural gap is explained by the overall action rate alone.

pressures.name: rare_override
pressures.definition: A conservative action dominates except in rare cued windows where a normally losing action pays two orders of magnitude more.
pressures.toy: Safe +1; risky -3 except in ~3% windows (noisy cue) where risky pays +60. Always-risky is strictly worse than always-safe.

controls.absent: no windows; risky always -3; cue still displayed
controls.shuffled: windows occur but the cue is independent of them

pressures.expected_effect: Present champions take the risky action mostly inside cued windows (conditional risk); absent are fixed-safe; shuffled are fixed-safe.
pressures.falsification: Present champions are fixed-safe or fixed-risky by P(risky | cue), or shuffled champions show the same conditional structure.

pressures.name: nonstationarity_within_lifetime
pressures.definition: The observation-to-correct-action map flips at unpredictable times inside one lifetime.
pressures.toy: Act on the sign of a noisy channel; the correct mapping reverses once at a random step in [15,45]; last reward visible as a channel.

controls.shuffled: mapping redrawn every step (present but unexploitable)

pressures.expected_effect: Present champions recover above chance after the flip; recovery length and persistent-state usage differ from absent.
pressures.falsification: Recovery after the flip is a one-step reflex on the last reward in every champion and persistent-state usage equals the absent control.

pressures.name: hidden_regime
pressures.definition: Two regimes with identical per-step observations demand opposite actions; the only evidence is a brief early cue; no reward channel.
pressures.toy: Regime bit per episode shown on a channel for the first 3 steps then replaced by noise; +1/-1 for the regime's action; 0 for abstain.

controls.shuffled: early cue independent of the regime

pressures.expected_effect: Present champions are above chance late in life; the no-persistent-state ablation destroys that.
pressures.falsification: Late-life accuracy at chance in every present champion, or the no-persistent-state ablation performs identically.

pressures.name: delayed_revelation
pressures.definition: A token early in life determines which action pays at a much later step; the interval carries distractor input on the same channel; no intermediate reward.
pressures.toy: Token +/-1 at step 2 (timing pulse on another channel); choice at step T-2 pays +50/-50; distractor noise in between.

controls.absent: token shown at the choice step (delay 0)
controls.shuffled: token independent of the paying action

pressures.expected_effect: Some present champions exceed chance at the choice step; the mechanism is robust to the distractor.
pressures.falsification: No present champion exceeds chance at the choice step.

pressures.name: resource_scarcity
pressures.definition: The same task under a tight budget of hidden nodes and ticks versus an abundant budget.
pressures.toy: W3 (changing rules) with 2 hidden nodes and 1 tick per step, versus 12 hidden nodes and 4 ticks.

controls.shuffled: not applicable (scarcity has no cue to decouple); recorded as N/A

pressures.expected_effect: Scarce champions carry motifs absent from abundant champions at matched fitness, not just fewer of the same.
pressures.falsification: Scarce champions are subgraphs of abundant champions with no motif unique to scarcity.

pressures.name: incompatible_regimes
pressures.definition: Alternating blocks in which opposite behavioural biases are optimal; no regime bit; evidence only through outcomes.
pressures.toy: Three options; regime A: paying option rotates every 3 steps (+2 hit, 0 miss); regime B: option 0 pays +1, others -5; blocks of 15; obs = last reward, last action.

controls.absent: regime B replaced by a copy of A (one regime)

pressures.expected_effect: Present champions show separable ablation profiles (some nodes carry A-competence, others B-competence). MoE-ness is not scored.
pressures.falsification: No champion shows separable ablation profiles; competence degrades uniformly under every node removal.

pressures.name: transplantation
pressures.definition: Subgraphs are periodically cut from one lineage and spliced into another population or world; machinery that only works in its original context is destroyed by the move.
pressures.toy: Every k generations a random subgraph of the champion of world X is spliced into random members of world Y's population; retention over the next generations is measured.

controls.shuffled: random subgraph of equal size and edge count generated fresh, spliced the same way

pressures.expected_effect: Evolved subgraphs are retained above the random-subgraph rate on at least one world pair.
pressures.falsification: Retention of evolved subgraphs equals retention of random subgraphs of equal size.

pressures.name: ecological_coupling
pressures.definition: Another evolving population sets part of the payoff surface, which moves as fast as the other side adapts.
pressures.toy: Matching pennies with two evolving populations; each sees the opponent's last two choices and its own; A wins on match, B on mismatch.

controls.absent: opponent is an i.i.d. 50/50 policy (static, unexploitable)
controls.shuffled: opponent is a fixed periodic pattern (static, exploitable)

pressures.expected_effect: Either a Red Queen cycle (detector fires; null for machinery) or coupled champions carry structure absent from the static-opponent champions.
pressures.falsification: Cycle detector fires and coupled champions carry no structure absent from static-opponent champions.

pressures.name: developmental_construction
pressures.definition: The hereditary object is a small set of graph rewrite rules applied for a fixed number of steps; selection acts on the grown organism.
pressures.toy: Rules (match op -> add child with op, weights, input/output attachment, optional back-edge); grown for 4 steps from one seed node; evaluated on W4 and W3 against direct encoding at equal evaluations.
pressures.expected_effect: Developmental encoding reaches the preregistered fitness threshold in fewer generations on at least one world without being tuned to it.
pressures.falsification: Developmental encoding is no faster on either world, or faster only on the world its rule set was tuned by.

pressures.name: irreversible_commitment
pressures.definition: One action locks the organism into an option for the rest of life; a cheap probe reveals noisy evidence; committing early yields more paying steps.
pressures.toy: Noisy evidence channel; probe -0.1; commit A/B; after commit +2/-2 per step by correctness.

controls.absent: commitment reversible (choose each step at no cost)

pressures.expected_effect: Present champions probe for more than one step before committing and their commit accuracy exceeds a one-sample reflex.
pressures.falsification: Present champions commit on step 1 with the accuracy of the reversible-control champions; hidden-node trajectories show no accumulation.

pressures.name: dying_lineage
pressures.definition: An energy store declines each step; the safe action cannot keep up; the risky action has negative expectation and positive variance; fitness is lifetime length.
pressures.toy: Energy observed; safe +0.6, decay -1.0; risky 30% +6 / 70% -2; death at 0; +1 per step alive.

controls.shuffled: energy channel replaced by noise (state unobservable)

pressures.expected_effect: P(risky | energy) is decreasing in energy for present champions and flat for absent and shuffled.
pressures.falsification: P(risky | energy) is flat in present champions.

pressures.name: sparse_revelation
pressures.definition: The structure that matters is visible only in rare episodes.
pressures.falsification: not yet stated; must be written before a world is built

pressures.name: inheritance_of_consequences
pressures.definition: A descendant starts life with its parent's end-of-life state.
pressures.toy: deferred; needs a decision on inherited plastic state

pressures.name: variable_volatility
pressures.definition: The rate of environmental change itself changes.
pressures.toy: a block-length parameter of W3/W7 this cycle

pressures.name: cost_of_sensing
pressures.definition: Observations cost something; the organism can choose not to look.

pressures.name: fakeable_signals
pressures.definition: Signals between lineages can be faked; receivers are pressed to discount cheap signals.

pressures.name: seasonal_budget_reset
pressures.definition: Accumulated reward is periodically zeroed unless converted; pressure toward timing and anticipation.
